{"name":"f3ec11e5fa1496a47adf","layouts":[{"id":0,"position":{"x":0,"y":81,"z":4000,"width":1280,"height":2419,"tabOrder":4000}}],"singleVisual":{"visualType":"textbox","drillFilterOtherVisuals":true,"objects":{"general":[{"properties":{"paragraphs":[{"textRuns":[{"value":" ","textStyle":{"fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"12pt","color":"#212121"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"What is the Whiteboard?","textStyle":{"fontWeight":"bold","fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"11pt","textDecoration":"underline","color":"#212121"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"The Personalised Proactive Whiteboard is a search tool, based on coding within GP clinical systems. The tool identifies people who would benefit from a care coordination approach.  By bringing a range of information about that person together in one place, it can improve communication, collaboration, and patient care.  ","textStyle":{"fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"11pt","color":"#212121"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"History of the PPW","textStyle":{"fontWeight":"bold","fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"11pt","textDecoration":"underline","color":"#212121"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":" In June 2021, the first iteration of the Personalised Proactive Whiteboard (PPW) tool was piloted in one practice focusing on supporting patients in their last 12 months of life. The PPW tool was used to identify people that would benefit from a care co-ordination approach, taking a more planned, personalised approach to their care.  An interim evaluation carried out in April 2022 highlighted a positive impact, with more people dying in their place of preference, and fewer people dying in hospital. GPs acknowledged the benefits of this approach anecdotally reporting a reduction in emergency callouts/ appointments.  ","textStyle":{"fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"11pt","color":"#212121"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":" ","textStyle":{"fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"11pt","color":"#212121"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"Following the successful evaluation there was a period of consolidation in which the PPW tool was further developed with the support of Dr R Hollands.  This is the tool that is now being rolled out into phase 2.","textStyle":{"fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"11pt","color":"#212121"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"Phase 2 commenced in March 2023, it focused  on the rollout of the tool to a further 8 primary care networks and its use with additional cohorts including those identified as moderately or severely frail or with a diagnosis of dementia.  The flexibility of the tool enables PCNs to target specific cohorts relevant for their locality, supporting neighbourhood working. The way in which the tool is utilised by care coordinators, using a personalised, MDT approach closely aligns to the proactive care framework. As the tool has been utilised by more PCNs additional developments have been requested. ","textStyle":{"fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"11pt","color":"#212121"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"Why is it called a whiteboard?","textStyle":{"fontWeight":"bold","fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"11pt","textDecoration":"underline"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"The name came from the original concept which used a static whiteboard, on a wall within a GP practice.  Over time, the tool has developed within clinical systems and Excel, away from the original idea, but the name ‘Whiteboard’ has stuck.  The tool has also been known as the ‘Virtual Whiteboard’, with the word ‘virtual’ being added to demonstrate digital functionality.  During phase 2, the name was changed to ‘Personalised Proactive Whiteboard’.  The purpose of this was twofold, firstly to remove any confusion with the Virtual ward, and secondly, to emphasise the connection with delivering Personalised Proactive Care.
